body.statement: The concrete attainable model satisfies \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{att}}\subset\mathcal P_{\mathrm{full}}\); its uniform design gives \(\underline f\le f_Q\le\overline f\), and the population localized spline and Legendre Gram matrices have eigenvalues bounded away from zero and infinity uniformly in admissible \((h,k)\).
body.justification: This inclusion makes the upper theorem a genuine result on a fixed positive-density submodel rather than an estimator-defined class.
body.gap: KennedyBalakrishnanRobinsWasserman2024 states high-level Gram and density-pilot conditions; the proposition verifies them directly for a named uniform-design submodel.
body.consumer: The inclusion supplies an auditable benchmark for implementations that randomize or reweight enrollment to an approximately uniform local design.
